NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VIII: OUR OWN STORIES, SKILLS AND FUTURE (LCH-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)

Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A parent wants to put old words into the children's games: teach them in songs, or in the games themselves.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has realized the little ones only know a handful of the old words. (subject.He/she) wants to teach them, but lessons bore (friend) to tears. (friend) will only learn things inside games or songs. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) writes silly songs using the old words: the word for crab, the word for wave, the word for grandmother's grumpy face. (friend) sings them all day. Soon the other children are singing them too, and teaching their parents.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) changes the children's hiding game so you have to shout the old word for where you are hiding. (friend) learns twenty words in a week, mostly for very good hiding places.
